assumptions: transactions.status: {'Completed': 13962, 'Cancelled': 1689, 'Returned': 1431, 'Pending': 918}
transactions.customer_id not in customers: 0 (0 = clean)
transactions.product_id not in products: 0 (0 = clean)
inventory.product_id not in products: 0 (0 = clean)
Negative-margin rows: 5,315 = **38.07%** of completed transactions
discount_pct: 0%–25% (max unit_price 399.42 == max list_price 399.42: discounts applied against list price)
inventory.stock_on_hand: 0–299; stockout_flag=1 on 760 of 5,000 records
revenue = quantity × unit_price × (1 − discount_pct); margin = revenue − quantity × unit_cost (Completed only).
lost_revenue = revenue of Cancelled + Returned transactions (Pending excluded).
cancel_return_rate = (Cancelled + Returned) / total transactions.
Return rate in leak detection = Returned / (Completed + Returned).
Classifier 'prior' features (prior order count / prior return rate) are computed strictly from transactions *before* each transaction's timestamp — no future leakage.
Campaign ROAS proxy: attributed_revenue ≈ conversions × avg completed-order value of that channel/category (no true attribution key exists).

Leak detection: metrics aggregated per (category x region x channel x month) cells with >=8 transactions; z-scores computed within each category across all its cells; |z|>2.5 flagged (|z|>3.5 = high); capped at 25 strongest flags. NOTE: because the DATATHON generator independently randomizes costs/prices/statuses, many flags are clumps of synthetic noise — documented in EDA_REPORT.md, not business-certified drivers.

Cancel/return classifier: XGBoost on the specified features; trained on Completed vs Cancelled/Returned (Pending excluded). NO predictive signal found (AUC~0.49; bad rate ~18% uniform across all feature slices) — risk.json scores are schema placeholders and must not drive real decisions. A 5-model sweep (LogisticRegression, LeakGuard NN, RandomForest, XGBoost, MLP — see ml/MODEL_COMPARISON.md) confirmed AUC 0.487–0.508 across all families: no learnable signal.
Campaign ROAS proxy: attributed_revenue = conversions x avg completed-order value of that channel/category; no true attribution key exists in the data.
Forecast: monthly quantity per category (Completed only); next-3-month forecast = 3-month moving average of last 3 observed months.
Stockout risk: latest inventory record per product; risk = 0.5*stock-vs-threshold + 0.3*recent stockout history + 0.2*supplier delay vs lead time.
Customer segments: KMeans on standardized (recency, frequency, monetary, return_rate); k chosen by silhouette among k=4,5.
Campaign channels include Email and Social, which do not exist in transaction channels (App/Web/Store) — cross-channel attribution for Email/Social is approximate, not measured.
